description: The DEFAULT constraint with expressions, through the SQL surface - the DESCRIBE TABLE default cell, which carries the declared expression verbatim: literals (quoted back exactly), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP with and without parentheses, CURRENT_DATE, arithmetic, function calls, concatenation, CASE, negative numbers, complex and parenthesized expressions, several defaulted columns in one table, DEFAULT NULL leaving the column nullable, booleans, and decimal expressions. Converted 1:1 from features/DefaultExpressionTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE test1 (id INTEGER, status VARCHAR DEFAULT 'active')
CREATE TABLE test2 (id INTEGER, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
CREATE TABLE test3 (id INTEGER, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
CREATE TABLE test4 (id INTEGER, date_col DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
CREATE TABLE test5 (id INTEGER, quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 10 + 5)
CREATE TABLE test6 (id INTEGER, upper_name VARCHAR DEFAULT UPPER('test'))
CREATE TABLE test7 (id INTEGER, full_name VARCHAR DEFAULT 'Mr. ' || 'Unknown')
CREATE TABLE test8 (id INTEGER, priority VARCHAR DEFAULT CASE WHEN 1 = 1 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END)
CREATE TABLE test9 (id INTEGER, balance INTEGER DEFAULT -100)
CREATE TABLE test10 (id INTEGER, computed INTEGER DEFAULT (10 * 5) + (20 - 5))
CREATE TABLE test11 (id INTEGER, value INTEGER DEFAULT (100))
CREATE TABLE test12 (id INTEGER DEFAULT 0, name VARCHAR DEFAULT 'unnamed', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, count INTEGER DEFAULT 5 * 2)

SELECT CONTAINS(MAX(IFF("name" = 'ID', "default", NULL)), '0'), MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "default", NULL)), CONTAINS(UPPER(MAX(IFF("name" = 'CREATED_AT', "default", NULL))), 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP'), CONTAINS(MAX(IFF("name" = 'COUNT', "default", NULL)), '5 * 2') FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE test13 (id INTEGER, nullable_col VARCHAR DEFAULT NULL)
CREATE TABLE test14 (id INTEGER, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE)
CREATE TABLE test15 (id INTEGER, rate DECIMAL DEFAULT 3.14 * 2)
